description: Cost friction scenarios for all TradingView backtest evaluations

A.label: Reference
A.description: Zero-friction theoretical baseline. Used only as a ceiling reference. Never used as a production assessment.
A.note: SIMULATED ONLY. Not representative of real execution.

B.label: Realistic
B.description: Standard broker commission and 2-tick slippage on liquid instruments. Representative of normal intraday execution.
B.note: Primary evaluation scenario. Use for production assessments.

C.label: Stress
C.description: High spread / news event / illiquid session conditions. Models worst-case retail execution.
C.note: Stress test only. If a strategy fails Scenario C it still may be valid under Scenario B.
